_comment: Config compartida del arnés (committeada). Preferencias personales (allowlist de permisos, etc.) en .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

hooks.command: sh -c 'git diff --quiet HEAD -- backend web packages mobile supabase/migrations 2>/dev/null && exit 0; ./verificar.sh > /tmp/harness_verificar.log 2>&1 && echo "[harness] verificar.sh OK" || { echo "[harness] verificar.sh FALLO -- revisa /tmp/harness_verificar.log antes de cerrar"; tail -25 /tmp/harness_verificar.log; }'
hooks.description: Al cerrar la sesion, si hay cambios de codigo vs HEAD, corre verificar.sh.
